I apologize for the
very short notice.

<name hero>, please
check out the underground
waterway at once!

Let me briefly give you
a quick summary:

You know about the caves
beneath Ragol's surface?

Yes. Those are the ones
I'm talking about.

There's a waterway that
connects those caves,
underground.

We lost contact with one
of our scout teams when
they got near it.

So, we sent out a search
team, but we haven't 
heard back from them!

This does not bode well
at all...

I'll... let Irene give
you the rest of the
details. Sorry...
I'm counting on you.

Please speak to Irene,
my secretary.

Please, <name hero>,
check out the underground
waterway at once!
Don't let me down!

I heard about the animals
you've seen from the 
scientists at our Lab.

It seems that our initial
perception of Ragol was
wrong.

Based on recent data,
Ragol isn't the paradise
Pioneer 1 said it was.

We still don't know the
cause of the explosion.

And we haven't heard
anything from the people
on Pioneer 1!

<name hero>, please...!
Continue investigating!

As thanks for helping out
our investigation, please
accept this <color 4>reward<color 0>.

Speak to Irene. She'll
give it to you.

I'll keep you in mind for
future jobs, as well.

I look forward to seeing
you put your skills into
action.

Speak to Irene to receive
your <color 4>reward<color 0>.

Rest up so that you will
be fully prepared for
your next job.

Where do you think you're
going?

You haven't spoken with
Irene for the details,
yet!

Excuse me.
Please wait a moment.

There!
Thank you for waiting!

Now, let me explain
the mission details.

You are to make your way
to the cavern waterway as
quickly as possible.

A teleporter has already
been set with the first
team's coordinates.

You should be able to
use that.

Unfortunately, we don't
have the coordinates
directly to the waterway.

So after you arrive at
the caves, please find 
the waterway with haste.

The team's final message
was: "There's a strange 
shadow in the water."

<name hero>, be careful.
Others were sent before,
but no one's returned.

I've got a really bad
feeling about this.
Take care, and...
Good luck.

Where does that
subterranean waterway
lead to?

What could this
"huge shadow" be?

Oh, I hope everyone's
all right...

Please, you have to hurry
and find out where it
goes!

The Principal is waiting.
Please give him your
report.
Great work, as always.

Here. Let me give you
this <color 4>reward item<color 0>.

I hope that you're able
to make good use of it!

Where are all of the
people from Pioneer 1?!

Do you think that they
fell prey to those huge
creatures?

They... they couldn't
have... r-right?

They've got to be alive,
somewhere!

Please, <name hero>.
You've got to find them!
We need your help!

Why don't you go and
relax for a bit?

You've already finished
this quest.

Please select "Cancel" at
the Counter to return to
the Lobby.

Oh, you're already
carrying too many items,
it seems.

Please come back when you
have some more room.
You received <color 4>reward item<color 0>!

The monsters in the caves
were mutations of the 
native wildlife, I think.

And this big
crustacean... It has a
needle shaped organ.

It's probably used to
inject its sap into 
other animals.

I may be too hasty, but I
think I have a theory...

I think that this sap is
mutating the native
wildlife into monsters.

The different creatures
in the caves seem to be
mutated wildlife.

Moreover, it doesn't look
like it was just a freak,
random mutation,

but something that was
intentional, and manmade.

Think about it:
All these incidents...

If that huge creature was
the cause, we should be
safe now.

And it was defeated by
you, <name hero> the
skilled <name job>!
What do you think?

Do you think more of
those creatures exist?
Nobody knows!

Ha, ha... there must be
more. Hundreds of
monsters like that...
